verdict.rationale: Qodo documents its own Agentic Toolbox CLI, which can be installed locally and used to "review changes before opening a pull request," so local pre-PR review from a CLI is covered. The docs frame the CLI mainly as a way to give a coding agent Qodo-managed skills, not as a standalone review command, and there is no evidence of CI-script usage or structured output. missing for 10: documented CI/headless invocation of reviews, machine-readable output format (e.g. JSON/SARIF), explicit local-diff targeting options, independent hands-on corroboration of CLI review.
